cost-management-object-storage-enable-ol: The Enable Object Lifecycle Management recommendation indicates that no lifecycle policy rules exist for an Object Storage bucket in your tenancy. Consider using Object Lifecycle Management to help manage object versions automatically.
downsize-exacs-x6-x7-x8-db-cluster: Downsize Underutilized Exadata Cloud VM clusters
cost-management-autonomous-database-unde: Downsize Underutilized ADW and ATP Databases
performance-block-volume-enable-auto-tun: Enable Performance Auto-tuning for Detached Block Volumes
performance-boot-volume-enable-auto-tuni: Enable Performance Auto-tuning for Detached Boot Volumes
cost-management-autonomous-database-unde: The Downsize Underutilized ADW and ATP Databases recommendation suggests reducing the OCPUs or storage for Autonomous Data Warehouse and Autonomous Transaction Processing databases in your tenancy. The recommendation indicates that the database is underutilized, and you can reduce its size to an appropriate level to reduce cost.
cost-management-compute-host-burstable-d: The Change Compute Instances to Burstable recommendation advises you to change the shape of an underutilized Compute instance to a corresponding burstable instance shape. Burstable instances provide a performance baseline with the ability to burst to higher performance for short periods of time.
cost-management-compute-host-terminated-: The Delete Idle Compute Instances recommendation suggests deleting Compute instances in your tenancy that have not been utilized for an extended period. The recommendation indicates that the Compute instance is idle, and you can delete it to reduce cost.
cost-management-load-balancer-underutili: The Downsize Underutilized Load Balancers recommendation suggests changing the shape of a load balancer to a lower bandwidth when it is underutilized.
cost-management-compute-enable-monitorin: The Enable Monitoring on Compute Instances recommendation indicates that a Compute instance in your tenancy does not have monitoring enabled. Enable monitoring to obtain CPU and memory utilization metrics.
cost-management-compute-host-underutiliz: The Downsize Underutilized Compute Instances recommendation suggests reducing the OCPUs for a Compute instance in your tenancy. The recommendation indicates that the Compute instance is underutilized, and you can reduce its size to an appropriate level to reduce cost.
cost-management-object-storage-enable-ol: The Enable Object Lifecycle Management recommendation indicates that no lifecycle policy rules exist for an Object Storage bucket in your tenancy. Consider using Object Lifecycle Management to help manage object versions automatically.
downsize-exacs-x6-x7-x8-db-cluster-desc: The Downsize Underutilized Exadata Cloud VM Clusters recommendation suggests reducing the OCPUs for an Exadata Cloud VM cluster in your tenancy. The recommendation indicates that the Exadata Cloud VM cluster is underutilized, and you can reduce its size to an appropriate level to reduce cost.
downsize-vmdb-system-desc: The Downsize Underutilized Base Database system recommendation suggests reducing the OCPUs for a Base Database system in your tenancy. The recommendation indicates that the Base Database system is underutilized, and you can reduce its size to an appropriate level to reduce cost.
create-ccd-commitment-desc: The Continuous Consumption Discounts (CCDs) recommendation advises customers to create a CCD commitment when it is financially beneficial for them.
cost-management-boot-volume-attachment-d: The Delete Unattached Boot Volumes recommendation suggests deleting a boot volume that is not currently attached to a compute instance. This recommendation appears when the volume has not been attached for a long time.
cost-management-block-volume-attachment-: The Delete Unattached Block Volumes recommendation suggests deleting a block volume that is not currently attached to a compute instance. This recommendation appears when the volume has not been attached for a long time.
enable-db-management-desc: The Enable Database Management recommendation indicates that a Database instance in your tenancy does not have Database Management enabled. Enable Database Management to obtain performance metrics.
rightsize-exacs-x6-x7-x8-db-cluster-desc: The Rightsize Exadata Cloud VM Clusters recommendation suggests increasing the OCPUs for an Exadata Cloud VM cluster in your tenancy. The recommendation indicates that the Exadata Cloud VM cluster is overutilized, and you can increase its size to an appropriate level to improve performance.
rightsize-vmdb-system-desc: The Rightsize Base Database system recommendation suggests increasing the OCPUs for a Base Database system in your tenancy. The recommendation indicates that the Base Database system is overutilized, and you can increase its size to an appropriate level to improve performance.
performance-compute-host-highutilization: The Rightsize Compute Instances recommendation suggests increasing the OCPUs for a Compute instance in your tenancy. The recommendation indicates that the Compute instance is overutilized, and you can increase its size to an appropriate level to improve performance.
performance-load-balancer-highutilizatio: The Rightsize Load Balancers recommendation suggests increasing the bandwidth for a Load Balancer when it is overutilized to improve performance.
performance-block-volume-enable-auto-tun: The Enable Performance Auto-tuning for Detached Block Volumes recommendation indicates that a Block Volume in your tenancy does not have the detached volume auto-tune feature enabled. Enable the detached volume auto-tune feature to optimize the performance settings of the block volume.
performance-boot-volume-enable-auto-tuni: The Enable Performance Auto-tuning for Detached Boot Volumes recommendation indicates that a Boot Volume in your tenancy does not have the detached volume auto-tune feature enabled. Enable the detached volume auto-tune feature to optimize the performance settings of the boot volume.
high-availability-compute-fault-domain-d: The Improve Fault Tolerance recommendation suggests increasing the availability of applications running on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure by using redundant compute nodes in different fault domains.
high-availability-object-store-enable-ve: The Enable object versioning recommendation suggests enabling versioning for an Object Storage bucket to increase data resilience against accidental or malicious deletion.
high-availability-object-store-enable-xr: The Enable object replication recommendation suggests enabling replication for an Object Storage bucket to increase data resilience across regions.
cost-management-desc: Cost management recommendations identify underutilized resources and help you reduce costs by finding and adjusting resources that are underutilized. Example: Cost management recommendations find underutilized Compute instances, overprovisioned Autonomous AI Lakehouse instances, detached block volumes, detached boot volumes, Object Storage buckets without lifecycle policy rules, and continuous consumption discounts (CCDs). Except for CCDs, cost management recommendations show you the resource utilization and its cost, the recommended utilization, the cost savings per month, and the number of cost management recommendations available for your tenancy at the time that the last scan was made. A CCD advises customers to create a CCD commitment when it is financially beneficial for them.
performance-desc: Performance recommendations find overutilized resources and recommend adjustments. For example, performance recommendations show you how to improve performance by rightsizing overutilized compute instances, load balancers, and databases. They show you how to optimize performance settings by finding block volumes and boot volumes that aren't using the detached volume auto-tune feature.
high-availability-desc: High availability recommendations provide hardware failure best practices to ensure the resilience of your solution and show you how to improve system resilience. For example, High availability recommendations might suggest increasing the availability of applications running on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure by using redundant compute nodes in different availability domains to support failover capability and correctly leverage fault domains.
